name: taskflow
description: TaskFlow — gerenciamento de tarefas com Supabase (PostgreSQL) e cache Redis

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > backend/src/types/database.types.ts && prettier --write backend/src/types/database.types.ts
